events.title: Demo Launch + Next Fest
events.summary: The Swordeye demo will launch within the next week and Swordeye will be in the October Steam Nextfest which runs from October 19th-26th. The demo will include the Open World, the T1 dungeon and the updated Ice Cave. In addition it will have an update to the Tower entrance, updates to the tutorial and much more. Check out the updated trailer below and I hope to see you all during next fest!

events.title: The Playtest Starts Today!
events.summary: The playtest will run from 1pm Pacific on 07-23-2025 through 07-27-2025. New features include a 1v1 tournament event, a queue for ranked duels, 1-handed weapons and shields, and much more. The first Othari Raid of the Playtest will start at 4:00pm Pacific Time and registration for the first tournament will start shortly after at 4:45pm Pacific Time. Looking forward to playing with you all! As us join the discord for more details!

events.title: Othari Raid -- Progress Update
events.summary: Major Updates and New Features This month I've focused on the new Othari Raid Event which is a co-op PvE focused event where an army of Othari swarm the sect outpost and players must defend with turrets, guards and the sect elders. Killing NPCs during the event gives special raid tokens which can be used to upgrade the sect turrets and guards to bolster your defenses. The goal is to survive the attack and slay the Othari general before your base falls. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601843/9eb36e4319327ae

events.title: Animation Overhaul -- February Update
events.summary: Major Updates and New Features Since playtest 8, in addition to working on addressing all of the player feedback, I've redone a lot of the animations, added proximity voice chat, a friend system with cross server dms, and tons more. Name Change I decided to change the name of the game from Swordai to Swordeye. I picked the name years ago before generative AI was a big thing like it is today. events.title: Playtest 6 is a Wrap
events.summary: Huge thanks to everyone who tried the game this playtest. It was awesome to hop on and fight with you all. Had a blast in duels, 3v3s and getting stream sniped with Firebox in the tower by players hunting my bounty. Counting only new players who hadn't launched the game before this playtest, there were over 10,000 tower runs, over 100K PvE kills, 30 million online damage dealt by players, 16K PvP kills and 34k chests looted.
